<template>
	<AsamConfigProvider :i18n="i18n"
		><main>
			<Teleport to="#preview-settings-extra" :disabled="!websitePreviewControls"
				><WebsiteAsamConfigProvider size="default"
					><section class="preview-control-group">
						<nav class="crud-demo-controls" :aria-label="text('示例选择')">
							<AsamButton @click="boundary = false" type="primary">{{
								text('完整CRUD')
							}}</AsamButton
							><AsamButton @click="boundary = true" type="primary">{{
								text('完整边界')
							}}</AsamButton
							><AsamButton @click="dark = !dark" type="primary">{{
								text('切换明暗')
							}}</AsamButton
							><WebsiteAsamCheckboxItem
								border
								:model-value="mounted"
								@update:model-value="mounted = $event === true"
								>{{
									text(mounted ? '卸载页面' : '挂载页面')
								}}</WebsiteAsamCheckboxItem
							>
						</nav>
					</section></WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
				></Teleport
			><template v-if="mounted"
				><BoundaryExample v-if="boundary" /><Example v-else
			/></template></main
	></AsamConfigProvider>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamCheckboxItem as WebsiteAsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');

import { AsamButton, AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref, watch } from 'vue';
import Example from './Example.vue';
import BoundaryExample from './BoundaryExample.vue';
import { useCrudLocale } from './I18n.js';
const { i18n, text } = useCrudLocale();
const boundary = ref(new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('boundary'));
const mounted = ref(true),
	dark = ref(false);
watch(dark, (value) => document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', value));
</script>
<style>
body {
	margin: 0;
	font-family: Inter, 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
	background: var(--el-bg-color-page);
	color: var(--el-text-color-primary);
}
main {
	max-width: 1440px;
	padding: 16px;
	margin: auto;
}
nav {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 8px;
}
button:not([class*='el-']),
input:not([class*='el-']),
select:not([class*='el-']) {
	font: inherit;
}
html.dark {
	--asam-color-surface: #1b2230;
	--asam-color-surface-page: #131a26;
	--asam-color-text-primary: #e4eaf5;
	--asam-color-text-regular: #d3dfef;
	--asam-color-text-secondary: #afbdd1;
	--asam-color-border: #3a465a;
	color-scheme: dark;
}
button:not([class*='el-']):focus-visible,
input:not([class*='el-']):focus-visible,
select:not([class*='el-']):focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--el-color-primary);
	outline-offset: 2px;
}
@media (width < 640px) {
	main {
		padding: 8px;
	}
}
</style>
